name: Anime Flat Style

concept.name: Anime Flat Style
concept.description:
This LoRA is designed to generate vibrant, clean anime artwork featuring bold, flat colors with minimal shading and depth—perfect for a striking, 2D-inspired aesthetic reminiscent of classic cel-shaded animation. It's trained on high-quality datasets to capture smooth gradients and vivid palettes while keeping things simple and eye-catching. Ideal for character designs, scenes, or illustrations that pop without complex details.

版本说明（Anima-Base）：
I don't know if this is a lot different since I trained on a preview before, now  I im doing it on a base model, have fun with the lora ^^
